author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first field log for hunters and anglers. Track harvests, catches, and time afield; keep a freezer inventory cut by cut; score your stands, blinds, and launches by hit rate; and hold your gear list, licenses, and tags in one place. Data lives on your NAS.
tagline: What you took, what you caught, where it came from

tips.before_install:
## Field Log

Data (harvests, catches, sits, spots, gear, freezer inventory, licenses and tags) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/field-log/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Field Log
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted harvest & catch log with on-NAS storage.
